humanRequest: Razmer okna — tozhe nablyudayemaya vkhodyasjhaya informaciya.
scope: Добавить typed observation ширины/высоты content viewport в points, явные source и initial/resize event, преобразование геометрии в общее состояние FUMA и derived layout. Только SwiftUI окна FUMA; не использовать AX или другие окна. Resize не вызывает AutomationExecutor и сохраняет пользовательский результат/историю. Не запускать Swift, build, test, GUI, Python или ROOT JSONL.

observation.validation: Both dimensions must be finite, positive and at most 16384 points. Rejections increment a separate geometry counter, preserve the last accepted geometry/layout, result and history, and never increment user-action or executor-call counters.

counterSemantics.userAction: Incremented when the model accepts an explicit one-step action; rejected geometry and layout changes do not increment it.
counterSemantics.executorCall: Incremented immediately before calling the existing AutomationExecutor; validation failures before that call do not increment it.
counterSemantics.geometry: Accepted and rejected observations have their own counters; invalid observations advance the observation sequence but preserve the last accepted dimensions and derived layout.

layout.flow: SwiftUI GeometryReader -> СостояниеЦиклаФУМА -> РаскладкаИнтерфейсаФУМА -> SwiftUI layout
layout.snapshotOrdering: Every actor-state mutation advances a monotonic version. The UI applies only snapshots with a strictly newer version, so late task resumptions cannot overwrite a newer displayed state.

fixture.resize: 900x480 points -> two columns and compact height
fixture.test: Run one user action against the existing executor, then apply both geometry samples; assert zero additional actions/calls, unchanged result/history, derived layout change, stale snapshot rejection after a newer snapshot, and rejection/preservation for NaN, infinity and zero.

status.source: written; source-only, not compiled or executed
